hero.title: Page header
hero.description: Eyebrow with the section, title, back on the left and actions on the right. On mobile, actions wrap to the next line.

empty.title: Empty state
empty.description: Explains why there's no content and offers the next step.
empty.body: Add your first patient to start tracking their care plan.

responsive.title: Responsiveness
responsive.description: Rules that apply to every screen.
responsive.r1: Below 1024 px, the sidebar becomes a drawer opened from the button at the top.
responsive.r2: Touch targets of at least 40 × 40 px.
responsive.r3: Wide tables get their own horizontal scroll; the page never scrolls horizontally.
responsive.r4: Respect safe areas (safe-area) on iOS and Android.
